headline: S&P considers downgrading Nvidia's credit rating over governance risks
summary: S&P Global Ratings is considering downgrading Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, citing governance and "key man" risks, including smuggling allegations and the lack of CEO succession planning.

claims.statement: S&P Global Ratings is considering downgrading Nvidia's credit rating.
